..pull-request-header: **Kestrel**: one app that replaces Radarr and Sonarr for usenet.
..pull-request-footer:
**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull kestrel && docker compose up -d kestrel`. Kestrel migrates its database on start and keeps the newest five backups in `/config/backups`.

**Image:** `ghcr.io/hyprsh/kestrel:latest`, or pin `X.Y.Z` · **Silo plugin repository:** `https://github.com/hyprsh/kestrel/releases/latest/download/silo-repository.json`
